title.en: Rivers: Indus, Ganga, Brahmaputra and Peninsular
title.as: নদী: সিন্ধু, গংগা, ব্ৰহ্মপুত্ৰ আৰু দ্বীপকোষীয়

description.en: Important questions on the major rivers of India - Indus, Ganga, Brahmaputra and the peninsular rivers - for Assam competitive exams.
description.as: ভাৰতৰ মূল নদীসমূহ — সিন্ধু, গংগা, ব্ৰহ্মপুত্ৰ আৰু দ্বীপকোষীয় নদী — সম্পৰ্কে অসম প্ৰতিযোগিতামূলক পৰীক্ষাৰ বাবে গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ প্ৰশ্ন।

q.en: Which is the longest river of India?

a.en: The Ganga, with a total length of about 2,525 kilometres.
a.as: গংগা নদী, মুঠ দৈৰ্ঘ্য প্ৰায় ২,৫২৫ কিলোমিটাৰ।

q.en: Which is the longest river of the world flowing through India?
q.as: ভাৰতৰ মাজেৰে বৈ যোৱা বিশ্বৰ দীঘলতম নদী কোনটো?

q.en: Where does the Ganga originate?

a.en: From the Gangotri glacier in Uttarakhand.

q.en: What is the name of the source stream of the Ganga?
q.as: গংগা নদীৰ উৎস সোঁতৰ নাম কি?

q.en: At which place does the Alaknanda meet the Bhagirathi?
q.as: অলকনন্দা আৰু ভাগীৰথী ক'ত মিলিত হয়?

q.en: Where does the Ganga fall into the sea?
q.as: গংগা নদী সাগৰত ক'ত পতিত হয়?

a.en: Into the Bay of Bengal through the Sundarbans delta.

q.en: Which is the longest tributary of the Ganga?
Where does the Yamuna originate?

a.en: From the Yamunotri glacier in Uttarakhand.

q.en: Which is the largest tributary of the Ganga by discharge?
q.as: পানীৰ পৰিমাণৰ দিশত গংগা নদীৰ বৃহত্তম উপনদী কোনটো?

a.en: The Son and the Ghaghara are major tributaries.

q.en: Where does the Brahmaputra originate?

a.en: From the Chemayungdung glacier near Manasarovar in Tibet.
a.as: তিব্বতৰ মানসৰোৱৰৰ ওচৰৰ চেমায়ুংদুং হিমবাহৰ পৰা।

q.en: What is the name of the Brahmaputra in Tibet?
Through which region does the Brahmaputra enter India?
q.as: ব্ৰহ্মপুত্ৰ কোন অঞ্চলৰ মাজেৰে ভাৰতত প্ৰৱেশ কৰে?

a.en: Through Arunachal Pradesh (at the Namcha Barwa area).

q.en: What is the name of the Brahmaputra in Arunachal Pradesh?
Which is the largest river of the Barak valley?
What is the name of the Barak river in Bangladesh?
Which is the longest peninsular river of India?

a.en: The Godavari, with a length of about 1,465 kilometres.

q.en: Where does the Godavari originate?

a.en: From the Trimbakeshwar hills in Nashik, Maharashtra.

q.en: Which is the second longest river of the Peninsular India?
q.as: দ্বীপকোষীয় ভাৰতৰ দ্বিতীয় দীঘলতম নদী কোনটো?

q.en: Where does the Krishna originate?
Which is the southernmost river of India?
Where does the Kaveri originate?

a.en: From Brahmagiri in the Western Ghats, Karnataka.

q.en: Which river is known as the 'Ganga of the South'?
Which is the west-flowing major river of the Peninsular India?
q.as: দ্বীপকোষীয় ভাৰতৰ পশ্চিমমুখী মুখ্য নদী কোনটো?

q.en: Where does the Narmada originate?

a.en: From the Amarkantak plateau in Madhya Pradesh.

q.en: Which is the river that flows through a rift valley in India?
q.as: ভাৰতত খাত উপত্যকাৰ মাজেৰে বৈ যোৱা নদী কোনটো?

q.en: Which river forms the largest waterfall of India?
q.as: ভাৰতৰ বৃহত্তম জলপ্ৰপাত গঠন কৰা নদী কোনটো?

a.en: The Sharavati river forms the Jog falls.
a.as: শৰাৱতী নদীয়ে যোগ জলপ্ৰপাত গঠন কৰে।

q.en: Which river is the longest tributary of the Brahmaputra in Assam?
Which is the major north-bank tributary of the Brahmaputra?

a.en: The Subansiri, Siang, Dibang, Lohit and the Manas.
a.as: সুবানসিৰি, চিয়াং, ডিবাং, লোহিত আৰু মানস।

q.en: Which is the major south-bank tributary of the Brahmaputra?

a.en: The Kopili, Dihing, Dhansiri and the Burhidihing.

q.en: Which river flows through the Mawsynram region of Meghalaya?
q.as: মেঘালয়ৰ মৌচিনৰাম অঞ্চলৰ মাজেৰে কোন নদী বৈ যায়?

a.en: The Umiam river and its tributaries.

q.en: Which river is called the 'Sorrow of Bengal'?
Which river is called the 'Sorrow of Bihar'?
Which river flows through the Thar desert?
q.as: থৰ মৰুভূমিৰ মাজেৰে কোন নদী বৈ যায়?

q.en: Which is the longest river of the North-East India?
Which river of India flows into the Arabian Sea?
q.as: ভাৰতৰ কোন নদী আৰব সাগৰত পতিত হয়?

a.en: The Narmada, Tapi, Sabarmati and the Mahi.
